note: Removes the ticket-specific default highlight label and hardcoded stale tooltip from the groups component; callers now pass label and tooltip text via props.
Adds a replay_vision_distinct_id helper in the temporal constants module and uses it in emit_observation_event and other activities instead of the inline f-string.
Deletes the group-mapping-emptied counter from hypercache.py and defines it in feature_flags local_evaluation.py; also counts dependency-unavailable skips in sync.
Handles oversized numeric flag ids in remote config lookup (returns 404 instead of panicking) and parameterizes tests; the duplicated flag_service helper is untouched.
Adds per-team RBAC filtering of flags in the org feature flag retrieve and keys endpoints; the dict comprehension and representative_by_key lookup remain.
Removes the MCP-tool-only information_schema execution-mode override and moves the recompute-instead-of-cache logic into the HogQL query runner for all callers.
Extracts a clear_feature_enrollment helper with raw-write fallback for demote/destroy cleanup; the raw filters feature_enrollment = True write is still present.
Changes banner copy from 'Last error' to 'Error' in the suspension message; no engine constant introduced.
Adds UNKNOWN_KEYS_SINK_CONTEXT_KEY and FLAG_ID_CONTEXT_KEY constants in filters_schema and uses them in both the reader and the audit command's context.
Splits the recordings server into a separate recording-api-server and an ingestion-session-replay-server, with separate compose/mprocs services for the API.
